I got your mail.￥Thank you. See you￥at training, then.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.01￥----------------------------------￥  There is a hidden stat for your￥  bond with each candidate:￥  Closeness. Closeness levels￥  decide whether key events￥  will happen.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.02￥----------------------------------￥  Candidates you rarely see can￥  gain Closeness if you talk to￥  them at the weekend meeting.

ALPHA DATABASE No.03￥----------------------------------￥  As Stress builds up, you are￥  more likely to collapse, and￥  your training results suffer.￥  Resting early makes your￥  training more efficient.
ALPHA DATABASE No.04￥----------------------------------￥  Closeness seems to rise when￥  you talk to candidates and￥  communicate with them.
ALPHA DATABASE No.05￥----------------------------------￥  If your grades are too poor,￥  special training from the￥  supervisors awaits, and the￥  candidates' Affection for you￥  will drop sharply.
ALPHA DATABASE No.06￥----------------------------------￥  Closeness and Affection are￥  key factors in triggering￥  events with a candidate.
ALPHA DATABASE No.07￥----------------------------------￥  Get close to a candidate and￥  leave a good impression, and￥  they'll start following you￥  wherever you go.
ALPHA DATABASE No.08￥----------------------------------￥  Joint training raises Stress￥  sharply, but in exchange it￥  can change stats by a lot.

ALPHA DATABASE No.09￥----------------------------------￥  In joint training, the partner's￥  Affection for you is key. Train￥  with someone who dislikes you￥  and results may be worse than￥  training alone.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.10￥----------------------------------￥  In joint training, whoever has￥  the higher stat in that subject￥  becomes the coach. Check the￥  other candidates' stats at the￥  weekend meeting.

ALPHA DATABASE No.11￥----------------------------------￥  Before joint training, check￥  whether your partner is strong￥  in that subject, and make sure￥  it isn't their weak one. Don't￥  let a candidate who is weak in￥  it end up as the coach...

ALPHA DATABASE No.12￥----------------------------------￥  If you collapse on a weekend,￥  a close candidate may come to￥  visit you.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.13￥----------------------------------￥  The order of the exams changes￥  with every playthrough.

ALPHA DATABASE No.14￥----------------------------------￥  Candidates adjust their training￥  to the monthly exam. Always￥  check what the exam covers.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.15￥----------------------------------￥  Each candidate has one "Strong￥  Subject" and one "Weak Subject."

ALPHA DATABASE No.16￥----------------------------------￥  On set days of the week, each￥  candidate is always at the￥  facility for their strong￥  subject. Pay attention to the￥  talk in the hallways.

ALPHA DATABASE No.17￥----------------------------------￥  A candidate's lines change in￥  many ways depending on "Mood."{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.18￥----------------------------------￥  Each "Mood" has training￥  subjects that suit it. Figure￥  out the pattern, and you can￥  help a candidate out.

ALPHA DATABASE No.19￥----------------------------------￥  Some training subjects are bad￥  for certain Moods. Figure out￥  the pattern, and you can even￥  trip up someone you dislike.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.20￥----------------------------------￥  The 3 stats checked in the￥  monthly exam include one main￥  stat and two sub stats. The￥  main one seems to carry more￥  weight in many ways.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.21￥----------------------------------￥  When choosing a partner, being￥  close is a given, but their￥  "Affection" matters just as￥  much. No matter how close you￥  are, if they don't like you,￥  they won't be your partner.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.22￥----------------------------------￥  See all of your target's events￥  before you clear the game, and￥  the ending will be more lavish￥  than usual.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.23￥----------------------------------￥  In a "Normal" mood, Stamina and￥  Tech training work well.
ALPHA DATABASE No.24￥----------------------------------￥  In a "Happy" mood, Judgment and￥  Intellect training work well.
ALPHA DATABASE No.25￥----------------------------------￥  In a "Sad" mood, Sense and Grit￥  training work well.
ALPHA DATABASE No.26￥----------------------------------￥  In an "Angry" mood, Piloting and￥  Strength training work well.

ALPHA DATABASE No.27￥----------------------------------￥  In a "Normal" mood, Intellect￥  and Sense training go badly.{00}{00}ALPHA DATABASE No.28￥----------------------------------￥  In a "Happy" mood, Tech and￥  Strength training go badly.
ALPHA DATABASE No.29￥----------------------------------￥  In a "Sad" mood, Stamina and￥  Piloting training go badly.
ALPHA DATABASE No.30￥----------------------------------￥  In an "Angry" mood, Grit and￥  Judgment training go badly.
ALPHA DATABASE No.31￥----------------------------------￥  The supervisors apparently go￥  to set places every day.
ALPHA DATABASE No.32￥----------------------------------￥  There seems to be someone in￥  this facility you haven't met.￥  Top marks or total slacking...￥  Playing to an extreme may￥  bring them out.
